contract.canonicalization: UTF8 compact JSON with recursively sorted object keys and ensure_ascii=false; descriptors contain strings, integers, booleans and string arrays only
contract.document_sha256_allowlist: Exact admitted office-document hashes are reserved to office provenance mode and cannot omit it to fall through native-print mode
contract.duplicate_policy: Unique admitted PDF byte hash per descriptor; repeated original source occurrences remain in the private occurrence manifest; no preferred financial copy is selected
contract.identity_authority_limit: Continuity to preserved original tax-source records only. No government identity verification, legal name change, literal name-variation cause, current legal name, as-filed status, full-return completeness or financial approval is established.
contract.identity_qualification: Original name match remains unverified; taxpayer identifier continuity matched.
contract.mixed_owner_year_review_sha256_semantics: Hash of an actual ordered whole-packet labeled-reference/header and official-T1-page-year proof artifact derived from the independently reviewed source packet. Every page must be covered; missing or foreign references and unclosed headers remain held.
contract.owner_year_evidence_sha256_semantics: Hash of the complete canonical document-specific combined evidence artifact containing source-continuity proof and independent original Info1/context/whole-packet review, including their exact source hashes. It preserves original name-match-unverified status and no raw SIN/DOB values.
contract.owner_year_requirement: Exact full unmasked taxpayer SIN and explicitly labeled taxpayer DOB on every actual T1 first page match one unique original client across source years and exactly one SAME-year/client/family original Info1 context. Original Info1 DCL/CRC, native record type/declared length, EXF/EXY/EXC member/year anchors and established SIN/DOB source field interpretations are independently verified. Printed official T1 year and every page labeled client reference plus archived full-name header/explicit-cover guards are independently verified. Original taxpayer name-cell match remains unverified; it is not required or asserted by this distinct continuity-only contract.
contract.page_count: Derived from ordered generic page_labels; original PDF bytes and page order never change
contract.profile_sha256_semantics: SHA256 of this canonical contract, not the closed profile file; full canonical descriptors are separately allowlisted
contract.source_and_financial_policy: Preserve source PDF bytes, existing client IDs/profiles and all figure/source-version records. Original name match remains unverified; taxpayer identifier continuity matched. No legal or literal name-change inference, profile/name edit, approved figure, calculated tax case, native-generation assertion, complete-return assertion or filed-copy assertion is made.
contract.source_manifest_sha256_semantics: Hash of the frozen two-record source-continuity review closed profile: it binds exact reviewed evidence digests, original CRC-verified source continuity proof, independent whole-packet review and established source-field authority. It is not a staging manifest.
contract.source_metadata_sha256_semantics: Hash of a separate source Creator/Producer metadata and original byte/stat evidence artifact; software generation is not inferred
contract.source_occurrence_manifest_sha256_semant: Hash of a separately frozen private source-occurrence manifest identifying exact original PDF paths, sizes, dates, hashes and corresponding original scan rows; never an API staging manifest
contract.static_pdf_review_sha256_semantics: Hash of a separate document-specific static PDF review artifact recording byte hash, page count and bounded object/action checks
